column1: # Named things that FAIRe mapper: find method details looks for in methods text. One row per thing.
# kind: what it is (instrument, thermocycler, master_mix, extraction_kit, cleanup_kit, software, pipeline,
#   database, filter, device, facility, qpcr_software). name: how the tool writes it. aliases: other
#   spellings, separated by |; spaces also match hyphens and no space, and a word may carry (R) or (TM);
#   an alias starting re: is a regular expression. case: exact for names that are also ordinary words
#   (otherwise any case matches). maker: manufacturer or developer. extra: for instruments the OBI
#   identifier; for filters the FAIRe filter_material; for extraction kits the FAIRe nucl_acid_ext_sep;
#   for taxonomy software the FAIRe tax_assign_cat; for pipelines and some software the web address.
#   uses: for software, the steps it does (trim, demux, merge, filter, denoise, cluster, chimera,
#   taxonomy, collapse, curation, decontam, normalise); for instruments the FAIRe platform; for commands,
#   parent= names the program they belong to. source: where the row comes from.
